title: dryopteris hololepis
intro: Dryopteris hololepis, commonly known as Chinese Lady Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of fern used in traditional medicine, particularly in Chinese and Ayurvedic practices, to support overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Dryopteris hololepis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic effects.
